title: Citadel Lens
description:
Evaluate and monitor your LLM, vision, and tabular AI systems. Additionally, the firewall extension precisely filters LLM input and output based on domain-specific rules. 

From out-of-the-box jailbreak testing for generative AI to ISO-compliant reports for predictive AI, Citadel AI provides a unified platform to measure, document, and manage AI risk.
